table agent_definitions
  | CREATE TABLE agent_definitions (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('global', 'workspace')),
  | workspace_id TEXT REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | name TEXT NOT NULL,
  | description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | instructions TEXT NOT NULL,
  | runtime_profile TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(runtime_profile) AND json_extract(runtime_profile, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | fallback_chain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"version":1,"profiles":[]}' CHECK (json_valid(fallback_chain) AND json_extract(fallback_chain, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | tool_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"version":1,"refs":[]}' CHECK (json_valid(tool_refs) AND json_extract(tool_refs, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | skill_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"version":1,"refs":[]}' CHECK (json_valid(skill_refs) AND json_extract(skill_refs, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | mcp_server_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"version":1,"refs":[]}' CHECK (json_valid(mcp_server_refs) AND json_extract(mcp_server_refs, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | permission_policy TEXT CHECK (permission_policy IS NULL OR (json_valid(permission_policy) AND json_extract(permission_policy, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | context_policy TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(context_policy) AND json_extract(context_policy, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | default_run_ttl_ms INTEGER CHECK (default_run_ttl_ms IS NULL OR default_run_ttl_ms >= 0),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'enabled', 'disabled')),
  | revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | CHECK (
  | (scope = 'global' AND workspace_id IS NULL) OR
  | (scope = 'workspace' AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL)
  | )
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 scope TEXT; not null
  column 3 workspace_id TEXT
  column 4 name TEXT; not null
  column 5 description TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 6 instructions TEXT; not null
  column 7 runtime_profile TEXT; not null
  column 8 fallback_chain TEXT; not null; default '{"version":1,"profiles":[]}'
  column 9 tool_refs TEXT; not null; default '{"version":1,"refs":[]}'
  column 10 skill_refs TEXT; not null; default '{"version":1,"refs":[]}'
  column 11 mcp_server_refs TEXT; not null; default '{"version":1,"refs":[]}'
  column 12 permission_policy TEXT
  column 13 context_policy TEXT; not null
  column 14 default_run_ttl_ms INTEGER
  column 15 status TEXT; not null; default 'draft'
  column 16 revision INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 17 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 18 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_definitions_owner on agent_definitions; origin c (owner_user_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_definitions_owner
  | ON agent_definitions (owner_user_id)
index idx_agent_definitions_owner_status on agent_definitions; origin c (owner_user_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_definitions_owner_status
  | ON agent_definitions (owner_user_id, status)
index idx_agent_definitions_workspace on agent_definitions; origin c (workspace_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_definitions_workspace
  | ON agent_definitions (workspace_id)
index idx_agent_definitions_workspace_status on agent_definitions; origin c (workspace_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_definitions_workspace_status
  | ON agent_definitions (workspace_id, status)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_definitions_1 on agent_definitions; unique; origin pk (id)
table agent_owner_deletions
  | CREATE TABLE agent_owner_deletions (
  | owner_user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | deletion_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  | lease_owner TEXT NOT NULL,
  | started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  | )
  column 0 owner_user_id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 deletion_token TEXT; not null
  column 2 lease_owner TEXT; not null
  column 3 started_at INTEGER; not null
  column 4 expires_at INTEGER; not null
index idx_agent_owner_deletions_expires on agent_owner_deletions; origin c (expires_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_owner_deletions_expires
  | ON agent_owner_deletions (expires_at)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_owner_deletions_1 on agent_owner_deletions; unique; origin pk (owner_user_id)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_owner_deletions_2 on agent_owner_deletions; unique; origin u (deletion_token)
table agent_run_attempts
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_attempts (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_index >= 0),
  | profile_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (profile_index >= 0),
  | runtime_profile TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(runtime_profile) AND json_extract(runtime_profile, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('preparing', 'running', 'waiting', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  | public_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | native_resume_token TEXT CHECK (native_resume_token IS NULL OR json_valid(native_resume_token)),
  | recovery_envelope TEXT CHECK (recovery_envelope IS NULL OR (json_valid(recovery_envelope) AND json_extract(recovery_envelope, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | checkpoint_at INTEGER,
  | completed_at INTEGER,
  | error TEXT CHECK (error IS NULL OR (json_valid(error) AND json_extract(error, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | CHECK (
  | (status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR
  | (status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND completed_at IS NULL)
  | ),
  | UNIQUE (run_id, attempt_index),
  | UNIQUE (public_session_id)
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 run_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 attempt_index INTEGER; not null
  column 3 profile_index INTEGER; not null
  column 4 runtime_profile TEXT; not null
  column 5 status TEXT; not null
  column 6 public_session_id TEXT; not null
  column 7 native_resume_token TEXT
  column 8 recovery_envelope TEXT
  column 9 started_at INTEGER; not null
  column 10 checkpoint_at INTEGER
  column 11 completed_at INTEGER
  column 12 error TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_run_attempts_run_status on agent_run_attempts; origin c (run_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_attempts_run_status
  | ON agent_run_attempts (run_id, status)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_attempts_1 on agent_run_attempts; unique; origin pk (id)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_attempts_2 on agent_run_attempts; unique; origin u (run_id, attempt_index)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_attempts_3 on agent_run_attempts; unique; origin u (public_session_id)
table agent_run_cleanup_jobs
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_cleanup_jobs (
  | run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | context_manifest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(context_manifest)),
  | execution_environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(execution_environment)),
  | attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  | last_error TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  | )
  column 0 run_id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 context_manifest TEXT; not null
  column 3 execution_environment TEXT; not null
  column 4 attempts INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 5 last_error TEXT
  column 6 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 7 updated_at INTEGER; not null
index idx_agent_run_cleanup_jobs_owner on agent_run_cleanup_jobs; origin c (owner_user_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_cleanup_jobs_owner
  | ON agent_run_cleanup_jobs (owner_user_id)
index idx_agent_run_cleanup_jobs_updated on agent_run_cleanup_jobs; origin c (updated_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_cleanup_jobs_updated
  | ON agent_run_cleanup_jobs (updated_at)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_cleanup_jobs_1 on agent_run_cleanup_jobs; unique; origin pk (run_id)
table agent_run_events
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_events (
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq >= 0),
  | attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_run_attempts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | type TEXT NOT NULL,
  | payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload)),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | PRIMARY KEY (run_id, seq)
  | )
  column 0 run_id TEXT; not null; pk 1
  column 1 seq INTEGER; not null; pk 2
  column 2 attempt_id TEXT
  column 3 type TEXT; not null
  column 4 payload TEXT; not null
  column 5 created_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 attempt_id -> agent_run_attempts(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_run_events_attempt on agent_run_events; origin c (attempt_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_events_attempt
  | ON agent_run_events (attempt_id)
index idx_agent_run_events_created on agent_run_events; origin c (run_id, created_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_events_created
  | ON agent_run_events (run_id, created_at)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_events_1 on agent_run_events; unique; origin pk (run_id, seq)
table agent_run_interactions
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_interactions (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_run_attempts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('permission', 'context', 'user_input', 'parent_input')),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'resolved', 'rejected', 'cancelled')),
  | request_payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(request_payload) AND json_extract(request_payload, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | response_payload TEXT CHECK (response_payload IS NULL OR (json_valid(response_payload) AND json_extract(response_payload, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | resolved_at INTEGER,
  | CHECK (
  | (status = 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR
  | (status != 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)
  | )
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 run_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 attempt_id TEXT
  column 3 type TEXT; not null
  column 4 status TEXT; not null; default 'pending'
  column 5 request_payload TEXT; not null
  column 6 response_payload TEXT
  column 7 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 8 resolved_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 attempt_id -> agent_run_attempts(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_run_interactions_attempt on agent_run_interactions; origin c (attempt_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_interactions_attempt
  | ON agent_run_interactions (attempt_id)
index idx_agent_run_interactions_run_status on agent_run_interactions; origin c (run_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_interactions_run_status
  | ON agent_run_interactions (run_id, status)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_interactions_1 on agent_run_interactions; unique; origin pk (id)
table agent_run_watch_members
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_watch_members (
  | watch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_run_watches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | added_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | satisfied_at INTEGER,
  | PRIMARY KEY (watch_id, run_id)
  | )
  column 0 watch_id TEXT; not null; pk 1
  column 1 run_id TEXT; not null; pk 2
  column 2 added_at INTEGER; not null
  column 3 satisfied_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 watch_id -> agent_run_watches(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_run_watch_members_run on agent_run_watch_members; origin c (run_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_watch_members_run
  | ON agent_run_watch_members (run_id)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_watch_members_1 on agent_run_watch_members; unique; origin pk (watch_id, run_id)
table agent_run_watches
  | CREATE TABLE agent_run_watches (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | parent_run_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_turn_id TEXT REFERENCES turns(turn_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | condition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(condition) AND json_extract(condition, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | completion_behavior TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (completion_behavior IN ('wait', 'notify', 'wake', 'detach')),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'fired', 'cancelled', 'expired')),
  | delivery_id TEXT,
  | requested_turn_id TEXT,
  | delivery_status TEXT CHECK (delivery_status IS NULL OR delivery_status IN ('pending', 'delivered', 'undeliverable')),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | fired_at INTEGER,
  | delivered_at INTEGER,
  | CHECK (
  | (status = 'fired' AND fired_at IS NOT NULL) OR
  | (status != 'fired' AND fired_at IS NULL)
  | ),
  | CHECK (
  | (delivery_id IS NULL AND requested_turn_id IS NULL AND delivery_status IS NULL) OR
  | (delivery_id IS NOT NULL AND requested_turn_id IS NOT NULL AND delivery_status IS NOT NULL)
  | )
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 parent_run_id TEXT
  column 4 parent_node_id TEXT
  column 5 parent_turn_id TEXT
  column 6 condition TEXT; not null
  column 7 completion_behavior TEXT; not null
  column 8 status TEXT; not null; default 'active'
  column 9 delivery_id TEXT
  column 10 requested_turn_id TEXT
  column 11 delivery_status TEXT
  column 12 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 13 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 14 fired_at INTEGER
  column 15 delivered_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 parent_turn_id -> turns(turn_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 parent_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 parent_run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 3.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_run_watches_delivery on agent_run_watches; unique; origin c; partial (delivery_id)
  | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_agent_run_watches_delivery
  | ON agent_run_watches (delivery_id) WHERE delivery_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_agent_run_watches_owner on agent_run_watches; origin c (owner_user_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_watches_owner
  | ON agent_run_watches (owner_user_id)
index idx_agent_run_watches_parent_run on agent_run_watches; origin c (parent_run_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_watches_parent_run
  | ON agent_run_watches (parent_run_id)
index idx_agent_run_watches_workspace_status on agent_run_watches; origin c (workspace_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_watches_workspace_status
  | ON agent_run_watches (workspace_id, status)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_run_watches_1 on agent_run_watches; unique; origin pk (id)
table agent_runs
  | CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | definition_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_definitions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | definition_revision INTEGER CHECK (definition_revision IS NULL OR definition_revision > 0),
  | effective_definition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(effective_definition) AND json_extract(effective_definition, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | invocation_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (invocation_mode IN ('delegated', 'manual')),
  | completion_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (completion_mode IN ('wait', 'notify', 'wake', 'detach')),
  | parent_run_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_run_attempts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_turn_id TEXT REFERENCES turns(turn_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_message_id TEXT REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | parent_tool_call_id TEXT,
  | task TEXT NOT NULL,
  | task_search_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | agent_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | handoff_search_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | context_manifest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(context_manifest) AND json_extract(context_manifest, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | expected_result TEXT CHECK (expected_result IS NULL OR (json_valid(expected_result) AND json_extract(expected_result, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | execution_environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(execution_environment) AND json_extract(execution_environment, '$.version') IS NOT NULL),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'preparing', 'running', 'waiting', 'recovering', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  | waiting_reason TEXT CHECK (waiting_reason IS NULL OR waiting_reason IN ('permission', 'context', 'user_input', 'parent_input')),
  | active_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_run_attempts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | result_bundle TEXT CHECK (result_bundle IS NULL OR (json_valid(result_bundle) AND json_extract(result_bundle, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)),
  | latest_event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1 CHECK (latest_event_seq >= -1),
  | next_attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (next_attempt_index >= 0),
  | lease_token TEXT,
  | lease_owner TEXT,
  | lease_expires_at INTEGER,
  | heartbeat_at INTEGER,
  | checkpoint_at INTEGER,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | started_at INTEGER,
  | completed_at INTEGER,
  | archived_at INTEGER,
  | expires_at INTEGER,
  | CHECK (
  | (lease_token IS NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL) OR
  | (lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)
  | ),
  | CHECK (
  | (status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR
  | (status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND completed_at IS NULL)
  | )
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 definition_id TEXT
  column 4 definition_revision INTEGER
  column 5 effective_definition TEXT; not null
  column 6 invocation_mode TEXT; not null
  column 7 completion_mode TEXT; not null
  column 8 parent_run_id TEXT
  column 9 parent_attempt_id TEXT
  column 10 parent_node_id TEXT
  column 11 parent_turn_id TEXT
  column 12 parent_message_id TEXT
  column 13 parent_tool_call_id TEXT
  column 14 task TEXT; not null
  column 15 task_search_text TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 16 agent_name_snapshot TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 17 handoff_search_text TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 18 context_manifest TEXT; not null
  column 19 expected_result TEXT
  column 20 execution_environment TEXT; not null
  column 21 status TEXT; not null; default 'queued'
  column 22 waiting_reason TEXT
  column 23 active_attempt_id TEXT
  column 24 result_bundle TEXT
  column 25 latest_event_seq INTEGER; not null; default -1
  column 26 next_attempt_index INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 27 lease_token TEXT
  column 28 lease_owner TEXT
  column 29 lease_expires_at INTEGER
  column 30 heartbeat_at INTEGER
  column 31 checkpoint_at INTEGER
  column 32 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 33 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 34 started_at INTEGER
  column 35 completed_at INTEGER
  column 36 archived_at INTEGER
  column 37 expires_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 active_attempt_id -> agent_run_attempts(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 parent_message_id -> messages(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 parent_turn_id -> turns(turn_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 3.0 parent_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 4.0 parent_attempt_id -> agent_run_attempts(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 5.0 parent_run_id -> agent_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 6.0 definition_id -> agent_definitions(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 7.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_agent_runs_agent_name_search on agent_runs; origin c (agent_name_snapshot)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_agent_name_search

index idx_agent_runs_owner_workspace_status on agent_runs; origin c (owner_user_id, workspace_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_owner_workspace_status
  | ON agent_runs (owner_user_id, workspace_id, status)

  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_parent_attempt
  | ON agent_runs (parent_attempt_id)
index idx_agent_runs_parent_node on agent_runs; origin c (parent_node_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_parent_node
  | ON agent_runs (parent_node_id)
index idx_agent_runs_parent_run on agent_runs; origin c (parent_run_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_parent_run
  | ON agent_runs (parent_run_id)
index idx_agent_runs_status_lease on agent_runs; origin c (status, lease_expires_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_status_lease
  | ON agent_runs (status, lease_expires_at)
index idx_agent_runs_task_search on agent_runs; origin c (task_search_text)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_task_search
  | ON agent_runs (task_search_text)
index idx_agent_runs_workspace on agent_runs; origin c (workspace_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_workspace
  | ON agent_runs (workspace_id)
index sqlite_autoindex_agent_runs_1 on agent_runs; unique; origin pk (id)

table assistant_runtime_switches
  | CREATE TABLE assistant_runtime_switches (
  | id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  | node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | after_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,

table attention_notifications
  | CREATE TABLE attention_notifications (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('node', 'agent_run')),
  | target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | key TEXT NOT NULL,
  | fact TEXT NOT NULL,
  | kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('needs_input', 'finished', 'failed')),
  | reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('approval', 'question', 'completed', 'error', 'run_completed', 'run_failed')),
  | title TEXT NOT NULL,
  | body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'resolved', 'expired')),
  | resolve_reason TEXT CHECK (resolve_reason IS NULL OR resolve_reason IN ('answered', 'seen', 'stale', 'superseded', 'expired')),
  | claimed_by_window_id TEXT,
  | claimed_at INTEGER,
  | resolved_at INTEGER,
  | CHECK ((status = 'active') = (resolved_at IS NULL)),
  | CHECK ((status = 'active') = (resolve_reason IS NULL)),
  | CHECK ((claimed_by_window_id IS NULL) = (claimed_at IS NULL))
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 target_type TEXT; not null
  column 4 target_id TEXT; not null
  column 5 key TEXT; not null
  column 6 fact TEXT; not null
  column 7 kind TEXT; not null
  column 8 reason TEXT; not null
  column 9 title TEXT; not null
  column 10 body TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 11 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 12 status TEXT; not null; default 'active'
  column 13 resolve_reason TEXT
  column 14 claimed_by_window_id TEXT
  column 15 claimed_at INTEGER
  column 16 resolved_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table edges
  | CREATE TABLE edges (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | source_node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | target_node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'branch',
  | anchor_message_id TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER
  | , rev INTEGER, fork_kind TEXT, fork_boundary_message_id TEXT)
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 source_node_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 target_node_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 kind TEXT; not null; default 'branch'
  column 5 anchor_message_id TEXT
  column 6 created_at INTEGER
  column 7 rev INTEGER
  column 8 fork_kind TEXT
  column 9 fork_boundary_message_id TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 target_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 source_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table memories
  | CREATE TABLE memories (
  | row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  | id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('user', 'workspace')),
  | workspace_id TEXT REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('preference', 'fact', 'decision', 'convention')),
  | body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(body)) > 0),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'pending', 'superseded')),
  | origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('explicit', 'extracted')),
  | source_node_id TEXT,
  | source_message_id TEXT,
  | source_turn_id TEXT,
  | source_artifact_id TEXT,
  | source_risk TEXT CHECK (source_risk IS NULL OR source_risk = 'untrusted'),
  | supersedes_id TEXT REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, keywords TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', event_at INTEGER, observed_at INTEGER, import_source TEXT, import_ref TEXT, merged_into_id TEXT, user_edited_at INTEGER, topic TEXT,
  | CHECK ((scope = 'user' AND workspace_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'workspace' AND workspace_id IS NOT NULL))
  | )
  column 0 row_id INTEGER; pk 1
  column 1 id TEXT; not null
  column 2 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 scope TEXT; not null
  column 4 workspace_id TEXT
  column 5 kind TEXT; not null
  column 6 body TEXT; not null
  column 7 status TEXT; not null
  column 8 origin TEXT; not null
  column 9 source_node_id TEXT
  column 10 source_message_id TEXT
  column 11 source_turn_id TEXT
  column 12 source_artifact_id TEXT
  column 13 source_risk TEXT
  column 14 supersedes_id TEXT
  column 15 version INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 16 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 17 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 18 keywords TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 19 event_at INTEGER
  column 20 observed_at INTEGER
  column 21 import_source TEXT
  column 22 import_ref TEXT
  column 23 merged_into_id TEXT
  column 24 user_edited_at INTEGER
  column 25 topic TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 supersedes_id -> memories(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_memories_merged_into on memories; origin c; partial (merged_into_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_merged_into ON memories(merged_into_id) WHERE merged_into_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_memories_owner_scope_status on memories; origin c (owner_user_id, scope, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_owner_scope_status ON memories(owner_user_id, scope, status)
index idx_memories_owner_source_turn on memories; origin c; partial (owner_user_id, source_turn_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_owner_source_turn ON memories(owner_user_id, source_turn_id)
  | WHERE source_turn_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_memories_owner_updated on memories; origin c (owner_user_id, updated_at, row_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_owner_updated ON memories(owner_user_id, updated_at, row_id)
index idx_memories_supersedes on memories; origin c; partial (supersedes_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_supersedes ON memories(supersedes_id) WHERE supersedes_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_memories_workspace_owner_status on memories; origin c (workspace_id, owner_user_id, status)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memories_workspace_owner_status ON memories(workspace_id, owner_user_id, status)
index sqlite_autoindex_memories_1 on memories; unique; origin u (id)
trigger memories_fts_ad on memories
  | CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO memories_fts(memories_fts, rowid, body) VALUES ('delete', old.row_id, old.body);
  | END
trigger memories_fts_ai on memories
  | CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO memories_fts(rowid, body) VALUES (new.row_id, new.body);
  | END
trigger memories_fts_au on memories
  | CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF body ON memories BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO memories_fts(memories_fts, rowid, body) VALUES ('delete', old.row_id, old.body);
  | INSERT INTO memories_fts(rowid, body) VALUES (new.row_id, new.body);
  | END
trigger memory_turn_sources_memory_ad on memories
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_turn_sources_memory_ad AFTER DELETE ON memories
  | BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_turn_sources WHERE item_kind = 'memory' AND item_id = old.id; END

  | CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memories_fts USING fts5(
  | body,
  | content='memories',
  | content_rowid='row_id',
  | tokenize='trigram'
  | )
  column 0 body (untyped)

table memory_extraction_runs
  | CREATE TABLE memory_extraction_runs (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | after_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | through_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | -- memoryVersion(owner, workspace) and the newest tombstone when it started.
  | memory_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | tombstone_mark INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  | invalid_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | -- 'invalid_limit' | 'budget' | NULL: why the tools stopped serving this run.
  | stopped_reason TEXT,
  | token_budget INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | -- Michi's estimate: context_tokens is what the model holds now, estimated_tokens
  | -- what it has read and written so far (the context is re-read on every call).
  | context_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | estimated_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | reported_tokens INTEGER,
  | proposed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | dropped_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | no_change_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | summary TEXT,
  | error TEXT,
  | started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | finished_at INTEGER
  | , payload TEXT, related_memories TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extract')
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 job_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 run_id TEXT; not null
  column 5 config_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 6 after_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 7 through_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 8 memory_version INTEGER; not null
  column 9 tombstone_mark INTEGER; not null
  column 10 state TEXT; not null
  column 11 invalid_calls INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 12 stopped_reason TEXT
  column 13 token_budget INTEGER; not null
  column 14 context_tokens INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 15 estimated_tokens INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 16 reported_tokens INTEGER
  column 17 proposed_count INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 18 dropped_count INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 19 no_change_count INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 20 summary TEXT
  column 21 error TEXT
  column 22 started_at INTEGER; not null
  column 23 finished_at INTEGER
  column 24 payload TEXT
  column 25 related_memories TEXT
  column 26 kind TEXT; not null; default 'extract'
index idx_memory_extraction_runs_owner on memory_extraction_runs; origin c (owner_user_id, started_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memory_extraction_runs_owner ON memory_extraction_runs(owner_user_id, started_at)
index idx_memory_extraction_runs_workspace on memory_extraction_runs; origin c (workspace_id, owner_user_id, started_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_memory_extraction_runs_workspace ON memory_extraction_runs(workspace_id, owner_user_id, started_at)

  | END
trigger memory_recall_docs_full_ad on memory_recall_docs
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_full_ad AFTER DELETE ON memory_recall_docs BEGIN
  | DELETE FROM memory_recall_full_fts WHERE rowid = old.id;
  | END
trigger memory_recall_docs_read_outside_ai on memory_recall_docs
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_read_outside_ai AFTER INSERT ON memory_recall_docs
  | WHEN new.doc_kind = 'turn' AND new.read_outside = 0
  | AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM turn_trust tt WHERE tt.node_id = new.node_id AND tt.turn_id = new.ref_id)
  | BEGIN
  | UPDATE memory_recall_docs SET read_outside = 1 WHERE id = new.id;
  | END
trigger memory_turn_sources_doc_ad on memory_recall_docs
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_turn_sources_doc_ad AFTER DELETE ON memory_recall_docs WHEN old.doc_kind = 'turn'
  | BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_turn_sources WHERE item_kind = 'conversation' AND item_id = CAST(old.id AS TEXT); END
trigger memory_turn_sources_doc_hidden on memory_recall_docs
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_turn_sources_doc_hidden AFTER UPDATE OF hidden ON memory_recall_docs
  | WHEN new.hidden = 1 AND new.doc_kind = 'turn'
  | BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_turn_sources WHERE item_kind = 'conversation' AND item_id = CAST(new.id AS TEXT); END

table memory_user_profiles
  | CREATE TABLE memory_user_profiles (
  | owner_user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | -- JSON [{ "topic": "…", "text": "…", "refs": [{ "id": "mem-…", "rowId": 12, "version": 1 }] }], in order.
  | lines TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  | -- The language the lines are written in ('zh' or 'en'); NULL before the first build.
  | language TEXT,
  | -- Goes up with every rebuild: a session holding an older one is sent the new one.
  | version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | -- The user scope's memory version (memory_scope_versions) the lines were built from; NULL before the first build.
  | source_version INTEGER,
  | built_at INTEGER,
  | -- When the latest rebuild was planned: the next follows the cadence from here (extractionRun.profileRebuildDue).
  | attempted_at INTEGER,
  | -- Why the latest rebuild failed, or NULL.
  | last_error TEXT,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  | , requested_at INTEGER)
  column 0 owner_user_id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 lines TEXT; not null; default '[]'
  column 2 language TEXT
  column 3 version INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 4 source_version INTEGER
  column 5 built_at INTEGER
  column 6 attempted_at INTEGER
  column 7 last_error TEXT
  column 8 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 9 requested_at INTEGER
index sqlite_autoindex_memory_user_profiles_1 on memory_user_profiles; unique; origin pk (owner_user_id)
table messages
  | CREATE TABLE messages (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | role TEXT NOT NULL,
  | content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  | blocks TEXT,
  | tool_calls TEXT,
  | seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000)
  | , rev INTEGER, metadata TEXT)
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 node_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 role TEXT; not null
  column 3 content TEXT; not null; default ''
  column 4 blocks TEXT
  column 5 tool_calls TEXT
  column 6 seq INTEGER; not null
  column 7 created_at INTEGER; not null; default strftime('%s','now') * 1000
  column 8 rev INTEGER
  column 9 metadata TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_messages_node on messages; origin c (node_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_messages_node ON messages(node_id)
index idx_messages_node_role on messages; origin c (node_id, role)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_messages_node_role ON messages(node_id, role)
index idx_messages_node_seq_id on messages; origin c (node_id, seq, id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_messages_node_seq_id ON messages(node_id, seq, id)
index sqlite_autoindex_messages_1 on messages; unique; origin pk (id)
trigger messages_ad on messages
  | CREATE TRIGGER messages_ad AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.content);
  | END
trigger messages_ai on messages
  | CREATE TRIGGER messages_ai AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content);
  | END
trigger messages_au on messages
  | CREATE TRIGGER messages_au AFTER UPDATE ON messages BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.content);
  | INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content);
  | END

table multi_model_runs
  | CREATE TABLE multi_model_runs (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | native_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | caller_node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | caller_turn_id TEXT,
  | caller_message_id TEXT,
  | ask_message_id TEXT,
  | status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('proposed', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'interrupted')),
  | plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(plan_json)),
  | state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(state_json)),
  | revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | started_at INTEGER,
  | ended_at INTEGER,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 native_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 caller_node_id TEXT; not null
  column 5 caller_turn_id TEXT
  column 6 caller_message_id TEXT
  column 7 ask_message_id TEXT
  column 8 status TEXT; not null
  column 9 plan_json TEXT; not null
  column 10 state_json TEXT; not null
  column 11 revision INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 12 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 13 started_at INTEGER
  column 14 ended_at INTEGER
  column 15 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 caller_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  | CREATE TABLE multi_model_turns (
  | turn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES multi_model_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | thread_key TEXT,
  | role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('answer', 'review', 'synthesis', 'addendum')),
  | round INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (round >= 0),
  | attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (attempt >= 1),
  | outcome TEXT CHECK (outcome IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'stopped', 'interrupted', 'withdrawn')),
  | error TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | ended_at INTEGER
  | )
  column 0 turn_id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 run_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 node_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 thread_key TEXT
  column 4 role TEXT; not null

  column 6 attempt INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 7 outcome TEXT
  column 8 error TEXT
  column 9 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 10 ended_at INTEGER

table nodes
  | CREATE TABLE nodes (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | tree_id TEXT REFERENCES trees(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | parent_node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chat',
  | title TEXT,
  | status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle',
  | position_x REAL,
  | position_y REAL,
  | minimized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | deleted_at INTEGER,
  | deletion_group_id TEXT,
  | spawned_by_agent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | current_mode_id TEXT,
  | pane_width REAL,
  | digest TEXT,
  | follow_ups TEXT,
  | follow_ups_source_message_id TEXT,
  | composer_draft TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000)
  | , acp_session_id TEXT, external_session_id TEXT, runtime_id TEXT, provider_id TEXT, model_id TEXT, reasoning TEXT, resume_fingerprint TEXT, trim_snapshot TEXT, purged_at INTEGER, rev INTEGER, last_applied_turn_id TEXT, last_applied_seq INTEGER, branch_overview TEXT, agent_definition_id TEXT
  | REFERENCES agent_definitions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, agent_definition_revision INTEGER
  | CHECK (agent_definition_revision IS NULL OR agent_definition_revision > 0), agent_effective_definition TEXT
  | CHECK (
  | agent_effective_definition IS NULL OR
  | (json_valid(agent_effective_definition) AND json_extract(agent_effective_definition, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)
  | ), pinned_at INTEGER, runtime_engine TEXT, permission_mode TEXT CHECK (permission_mode IN ('ask', 'trust', 'yolo')), crew_memory_mode TEXT CHECK (crew_memory_mode IN ('persistent', 'incognito', 'temporary')), forked_from_node_id TEXT, fork_boundary_message_id TEXT, inherited_message_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, page_id TEXT REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, maintenance_job_id TEXT, viewed_at INTEGER, permission_approve_for_me INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (permission_approve_for_me IN (0, 1)), ultracode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ultracode IN (0, 1)), completion_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_completed_at INTEGER, last_completed_turn_id TEXT, seen_completion_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, scheduled_only_job_id TEXT, multi_model_run_id TEXT, fresh_context INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fresh_context IN (0, 1)), memory_mode TEXT)
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 tree_id TEXT
  column 3 parent_node_id TEXT
  column 4 kind TEXT; not null; default 'chat'
  column 5 title TEXT
  column 6 status TEXT; not null; default 'idle'
  column 7 position_x REAL
  column 8 position_y REAL
  column 9 minimized INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 10 deleted_at INTEGER
  column 11 deletion_group_id TEXT
  column 12 spawned_by_agent INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 13 current_mode_id TEXT
  column 14 pane_width REAL
  column 15 digest TEXT
  column 16 follow_ups TEXT
  column 17 follow_ups_source_message_id TEXT
  column 18 composer_draft TEXT
  column 19 created_at INTEGER; not null; default strftime('%s','now') * 1000
  column 20 acp_session_id TEXT
  column 21 external_session_id TEXT
  column 22 runtime_id TEXT
  column 23 provider_id TEXT
  column 24 model_id TEXT
  column 25 reasoning TEXT
  column 26 resume_fingerprint TEXT
  column 27 trim_snapshot TEXT
  column 28 purged_at INTEGER
  column 29 rev INTEGER
  column 30 last_applied_turn_id TEXT
  column 31 last_applied_seq INTEGER
  column 32 branch_overview TEXT
  column 33 agent_definition_id TEXT
  column 34 agent_definition_revision INTEGER
  column 35 agent_effective_definition TEXT
  column 36 pinned_at INTEGER
  column 37 runtime_engine TEXT
  column 38 permission_mode TEXT
  column 39 crew_memory_mode TEXT

  column 43 page_id TEXT

  column 45 viewed_at INTEGER
  column 46 permission_approve_for_me INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 47 ultracode INTEGER; not null; default 0

  column 51 seen_completion_seq INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 52 scheduled_only_job_id TEXT
  column 53 multi_model_run_id TEXT
  column 54 fresh_context INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 55 memory_mode TEXT

trigger assistant_native_sessions_ai_v1 on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER assistant_native_sessions_ai_v1 AFTER INSERT ON nodes
  | WHEN (SELECT (CASE WHEN json_valid(settings) THEN json_extract(settings, '$.system') END) = 'assistant'
  | FROM workspaces WHERE id = new.workspace_id)
  | BEGIN
  | INSERT OR IGNORE INTO assistant_native_sessions (native_id, node_id, recorded_at)
  | SELECT new.acp_session_id, new.id, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
  | WHERE new.acp_session_id IS NOT NULL AND new.acp_session_id <> '' AND new.acp_session_id <> new.id;
  | INSERT OR IGNORE INTO assistant_native_sessions (native_id, node_id, recorded_at)
  | SELECT new.external_session_id, new.id, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
  | WHERE new.external_session_id IS NOT NULL AND new.external_session_id <> '' AND new.external_session_id <> new.id;
  | END
trigger assistant_native_sessions_au_v1 on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER assistant_native_sessions_au_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF acp_session_id, external_session_id ON nodes
  | WHEN (SELECT (CASE WHEN json_valid(settings) THEN json_extract(settings, '$.system') END) = 'assistant'
  | FROM workspaces WHERE id = new.workspace_id)
  | BEGIN
  | INSERT OR IGNORE INTO assistant_native_sessions (native_id, node_id, recorded_at)
  | SELECT new.acp_session_id, new.id, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
  | WHERE new.acp_session_id IS NOT NULL AND new.acp_session_id <> '' AND new.acp_session_id <> new.id;
  | INSERT OR IGNORE INTO assistant_native_sessions (native_id, node_id, recorded_at)
  | SELECT new.external_session_id, new.id, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000
  | WHERE new.external_session_id IS NOT NULL AND new.external_session_id <> '' AND new.external_session_id <> new.id;
  | END
trigger assistant_runtime_switches_au_v1 on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER assistant_runtime_switches_au_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF runtime_id ON nodes
  | WHEN old.runtime_id IS NOT NULL AND new.runtime_id IS NOT NULL AND old.runtime_id <> new.runtime_id
  | AND (SELECT (CASE WHEN json_valid(settings) THEN json_extract(settings, '$.system') END) = 'assistant'
  | FROM workspaces WHERE id = new.workspace_id)
  | BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO assistant_runtime_switches (node_id, after_message_id, previous_runtime_id, runtime_id, switched_at)
  | SELECT new.id, m.id, old.runtime_id, new.runtime_id, CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER)
  | FROM messages m
  | WHERE m.node_id = new.id
  | ORDER BY m.seq DESC
  | LIMIT 1;
  | END
trigger memory_recall_docs_node_ad on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_node_ad AFTER DELETE ON nodes BEGIN
  | DELETE FROM memory_recall_docs WHERE doc_kind = 'turn' AND node_id = old.id;
  | END
trigger memory_recall_docs_node_moved on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_node_moved AFTER UPDATE OF workspace_id ON nodes
  | WHEN new.workspace_id IS NOT old.workspace_id
  | BEGIN
  | UPDATE memory_recall_docs SET workspace_id = new.workspace_id WHERE doc_kind = 'turn' AND node_id = new.id;
  | END
trigger memory_recall_docs_node_purged on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_node_purged AFTER UPDATE OF purged_at ON nodes
  | WHEN new.purged_at IS NOT NULL
  | BEGIN
  | DELETE FROM memory_recall_docs WHERE doc_kind = 'turn' AND node_id = new.id;
  | END
trigger memory_turn_sources_node_ad on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_turn_sources_node_ad AFTER DELETE ON nodes
  | BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_turn_sources WHERE node_id = old.id; END
trigger memory_turn_sources_node_purged on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_turn_sources_node_purged AFTER UPDATE OF purged_at ON nodes
  | WHEN new.purged_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN DELETE FROM memory_turn_sources WHERE node_id = new.id; END
trigger nodes_fts_ad on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER nodes_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON nodes BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO nodes_fts(nodes_fts, rowid, title) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.title);
  | END
trigger nodes_fts_ai on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER nodes_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON nodes BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO nodes_fts(rowid, title) VALUES (new.rowid, new.title);
  | END
trigger nodes_fts_au on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER nodes_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF title ON nodes BEGIN
  | INSERT INTO nodes_fts(nodes_fts, rowid, title) VALUES('delete', old.rowid, old.title);
  | INSERT INTO nodes_fts(rowid, title) VALUES (new.rowid, new.title);
  | END
trigger turn_trust_node_purged on nodes
  | CREATE TRIGGER turn_trust_node_purged AFTER UPDATE OF purged_at ON nodes
  | WHEN new.purged_at IS NOT NULL
  | BEGIN
  | DELETE FROM turn_trust WHERE node_id = new.id;
  | END

  | CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE nodes_fts USING fts5(
  | title,
  | content=nodes,
  | content_rowid=rowid,
  | tokenize='unicode61'
  | )
  column 0 title (untyped)

table page_changes
  | CREATE TABLE page_changes (
  | seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  | id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | page_id TEXT REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | database_id TEXT REFERENCES page_databases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | target_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  | target TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(target)),
  | batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | op TEXT NOT NULL,
  | before_json TEXT CHECK(before_json IS NULL OR json_valid(before_json)),
  | after_json TEXT CHECK(after_json IS NULL OR json_valid(after_json)),
  | forward_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(forward_json)),
  | inverse_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(inverse_json)),
  | base_rev INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(base_rev >= 1),
  | applied_rev INTEGER,
  | previous_head_id TEXT,
  | source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(source)),
  | source_node_id TEXT,
  | proposal_state TEXT CHECK(proposal_state IN ('pending','accepted','dismissed')),
  | application_state TEXT CHECK(application_state IN ('applied','reverted')),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | resolved_at INTEGER,
  | CHECK((page_id IS NOT NULL) != (database_id IS NOT NULL)),
  | CHECK((proposal_state IS NULL AND application_state IS NOT NULL)
  | OR (proposal_state IN ('pending','dismissed') AND application_state IS NULL)
  | OR (proposal_state = 'accepted' AND application_state IS NOT NULL))
  | )
  column 0 seq INTEGER; pk 1
  column 1 id TEXT; not null
  column 2 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 page_id TEXT
  column 5 database_id TEXT
  column 6 target_key TEXT; not null
  column 7 target TEXT; not null
  column 8 batch_id TEXT; not null
  column 9 op TEXT; not null
  column 10 before_json TEXT
  column 11 after_json TEXT
  column 12 forward_json TEXT; not null
  column 13 inverse_json TEXT; not null
  column 14 base_rev INTEGER; not null
  column 15 applied_rev INTEGER
  column 16 previous_head_id TEXT
  column 17 source TEXT; not null
  column 18 source_node_id TEXT
  column 19 proposal_state TEXT
  column 20 application_state TEXT
  column 21 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 22 resolved_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 database_id -> page_databases(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 page_id -> pages(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_component_refs
  | CREATE TABLE page_component_refs (
  | ref_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | component_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | host_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(host_kind IN ('page_block','database_view')),
  | page_id TEXT REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | block_id TEXT,
  | database_id TEXT REFERENCES page_databases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | view_id TEXT,
  | pinned_version INTEGER,
  | protected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(protected IN (0,1)),
  | host_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(host_revision >= 1),
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | CHECK((host_kind='page_block' AND page_id IS NOT NULL AND block_id IS NOT NULL AND database_id IS NULL AND view_id IS NULL)
  | OR (host_kind='database_view' AND page_id IS NULL AND block_id IS NULL AND database_id IS NOT NULL AND view_id IS NOT NULL)),
  | CHECK(protected=0 OR pinned_version IS NOT NULL),
  | FOREIGN KEY(component_id,workspace_id) REFERENCES page_components(id,workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | FOREIGN KEY(component_id,pinned_version) REFERENCES page_component_versions(component_id,version) ON DELETE CASCADE
  | )
  column 0 ref_id INTEGER; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 component_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 host_kind TEXT; not null
  column 5 page_id TEXT
  column 6 block_id TEXT
  column 7 database_id TEXT
  column 8 view_id TEXT
  column 9 pinned_version INTEGER
  column 10 protected INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 11 host_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 12 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 component_id -> page_component_versions(component_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 0.1 pinned_version -> page_component_versions(version); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 component_id -> page_components(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.1 workspace_id -> page_components(workspace_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 database_id -> page_databases(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 3.0 page_id -> pages(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_page_component_ref_block on page_component_refs; unique; origin c; partial (owner_user_id, workspace_id, page_id, block_id)
  | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_page_component_ref_block ON page_component_refs(owner_user_id,workspace_id,page_id,block_id) WHERE host_kind='page_block'
index idx_page_component_ref_view on page_component_refs; unique; origin c; partial (owner_user_id, workspace_id, database_id, view_id)
  | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_page_component_ref_view ON page_component_refs(owner_user_id,workspace_id,database_id,view_id) WHERE host_kind='database_view'
index idx_page_component_refs_component on page_component_refs; origin c (owner_user_id, workspace_id, component_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_page_component_refs_component ON page_component_refs(owner_user_id,workspace_id,component_id)

  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | PRIMARY KEY(component_id,version)
  | )

table page_components
  | CREATE TABLE page_components (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | name TEXT NOT NULL,
  | description TEXT NOT NULL,
  | enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
  | active_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active_version >= 1),
  | latest_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(latest_version >= 1),
  | library_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(library_revision >= 1),
  | revocation_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revocation_epoch >= 1),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | deleted_at INTEGER,
  | UNIQUE(id,workspace_id)
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 name TEXT; not null
  column 4 description TEXT; not null
  column 5 enabled INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 6 active_version INTEGER; not null
  column 7 latest_version INTEGER; not null
  column 8 library_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 9 revocation_epoch INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 10 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 11 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 12 deleted_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_databases
  | CREATE TABLE page_databases (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | title TEXT NOT NULL,
  | columns_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(columns_json)),
  | views_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(views_json)),
  | revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | deleted_at INTEGER,
  | deletion_group_id TEXT
  | , role TEXT CHECK (role IS NULL OR role = 'tasks'))
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 title TEXT; not null
  column 4 columns_json TEXT; not null
  column 5 views_json TEXT; not null
  column 6 revision INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 7 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 8 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 9 deleted_at INTEGER
  column 10 deletion_group_id TEXT
  column 11 role TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  | ON page_databases(owner_user_id, workspace_id) WHERE role = 'tasks' AND deleted_at IS NULL

table page_first_runs
  | CREATE TABLE page_first_runs (
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | start_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start_seq >= 0),
  | read_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(read_count >= 0),
  | total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total >= 0 AND read_count <= total),
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','reading','writing','done','failed')),
  | error TEXT CHECK((state = 'failed') = (error IS NOT NULL)),
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, owner_user_id)
  | )
  column 0 workspace_id TEXT; not null; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null; pk 2
  column 2 started_at INTEGER; not null
  column 3 start_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 4 read_count INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 5 total INTEGER; not null
  column 6 state TEXT; not null
  column 7 error TEXT
  column 8 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_maintenance_catchup_requests
  | CREATE TABLE page_maintenance_catchup_requests (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | after_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(after_seq >= 0),
  | through_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(through_seq > after_seq AND through_seq - after_seq <= 1000),
  | space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(config_revision >= 1),
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','completed','cancelled')),
  | claimed_plan_id TEXT REFERENCES page_maintenance_plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,owner_user_id) REFERENCES page_maintenance_configs(workspace_id,owner_user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 after_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 4 through_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 5 space_id TEXT; not null
  column 6 config_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 7 state TEXT; not null
  column 8 claimed_plan_id TEXT
  column 9 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 10 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> page_maintenance_configs(workspace_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 0.1 owner_user_id -> page_maintenance_configs(owner_user_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 claimed_plan_id -> page_maintenance_plans(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 space_id -> pages(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  | revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),

  | reasoning TEXT,

  | PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, owner_user_id)
  | )

  column 4 paused INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 5 revision INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 6 completion_cursor INTEGER; not null
  column 7 runtime_id TEXT
  column 8 provider_id TEXT
  column 9 model_id TEXT
  column 10 reasoning TEXT
  column 11 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 job_id -> scheduled_jobs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_maintenance_plans
  | CREATE TABLE page_maintenance_plans (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | run_id TEXT REFERENCES scheduled_job_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(config_revision >= 1),
  | generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation >= 1),
  | scope_space_id TEXT,
  | reconsider_of_plan_id TEXT REFERENCES page_maintenance_plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | after_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(after_seq >= 0),
  | through_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(through_seq >= after_seq),
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('routing','processing','terminal','attention','cancelled')),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | UNIQUE(job_id, run_id),
  | FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES page_maintenance_configs(workspace_id, owner_user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 job_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 run_id TEXT
  column 5 config_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 6 generation INTEGER; not null
  column 7 scope_space_id TEXT
  column 8 reconsider_of_plan_id TEXT
  column 9 after_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 10 through_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 11 state TEXT; not null
  column 12 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 13 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 workspace_id -> page_maintenance_configs(workspace_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 0.1 owner_user_id -> page_maintenance_configs(owner_user_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 reconsider_of_plan_id -> page_maintenance_plans(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 run_id -> scheduled_job_runs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 3.0 job_id -> scheduled_jobs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 4.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
index idx_page_maintenance_plans_backlog on page_maintenance_plans; origin c (job_id, state, created_at)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_page_maintenance_plans_backlog ON page_maintenance_plans(job_id,state,created_at)

  | CREATE TABLE page_maintenance_receipts (
  | receipt_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES page_maintenance_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  | result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(result_json)),
  | outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('written','proposed','no_change')),
  | execution_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(execution_json)),
  | evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json)),
  | committed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | UNIQUE(job_id,source_turn_id,resource_kind,resource_id,generation)
  | )
  column 0 receipt_key TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 plan_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 job_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 source_turn_id TEXT; not null
  column 4 resource_kind TEXT; not null
  column 5 resource_id TEXT; not null
  column 6 generation INTEGER; not null
  column 7 payload_hash TEXT; not null
  column 8 payload_json TEXT; not null
  column 9 assigned_ids_json TEXT; not null
  column 10 result_json TEXT; not null
  column 11 outcome TEXT; not null
  column 12 execution_json TEXT; not null
  column 13 evidence_json TEXT; not null
  column 14 committed_at INTEGER; not null
  foreign key 0.0 job_id -> scheduled_jobs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 plan_id -> page_maintenance_plans(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_maintenance_resources
  | CREATE TABLE page_maintenance_resources (
  | plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | source_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resource_kind IN ('page','database')),
  | resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | observed_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(observed_revision >= 1),
  | generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation >= 1),
  | page_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(page_ids_json)),
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','written','proposed','no_change','skipped','attention')),
  | payload_hash TEXT,
  | payload_json TEXT CHECK(payload_json IS NULL OR json_valid(payload_json)),
  | assigned_ids_json TEXT CHECK(assigned_ids_json IS NULL OR json_valid(assigned_ids_json)),
  | receipt_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  | terminal_reason TEXT,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deferred_run_id TEXT,
  | PRIMARY KEY(plan_id, source_turn_id, resource_kind, resource_id),
  | FOREIGN KEY(plan_id, source_turn_id) REFERENCES page_maintenance_sources(plan_id,source_turn_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  | )
  column 0 plan_id TEXT; not null; pk 1
  column 1 source_turn_id TEXT; not null; pk 2
  column 2 resource_kind TEXT; not null; pk 3
  column 3 resource_id TEXT; not null; pk 4
  column 4 observed_revision INTEGER; not null
  column 5 generation INTEGER; not null
  column 6 page_ids_json TEXT; not null
  column 7 state TEXT; not null
  column 8 payload_hash TEXT
  column 9 payload_json TEXT
  column 10 assigned_ids_json TEXT
  column 11 receipt_key TEXT; not null
  column 12 terminal_reason TEXT
  column 13 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 14 deferred_run_id TEXT
  foreign key 0.0 plan_id -> page_maintenance_sources(plan_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE
  foreign key 0.1 source_turn_id -> page_maintenance_sources(source_turn_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  column 2 message_id TEXT; not null; pk 3

  column 4 byte_start INTEGER; not null
  column 5 byte_end INTEGER; not null
  column 6 part_hash TEXT; not null
  column 7 offered_at INTEGER; not null
  column 8 acknowledged_at INTEGER

  foreign key 0.1 source_turn_id -> page_maintenance_source_messages(source_turn_id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

table page_maintenance_sources
  | CREATE TABLE page_maintenance_sources (
  | plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES page_maintenance_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | source_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | completion_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(completion_seq >= 1),
  | evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json)),
  | manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(manifest_json)),
  | state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('routing','processing','terminal','attention','skipped')),
  | routing_complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(routing_complete IN (0,1)),
  | candidates_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(candidates_json)),
  | terminal_reason TEXT,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | PRIMARY KEY(plan_id, source_turn_id),
  | UNIQUE(plan_id, completion_seq)
  | )
  column 0 plan_id TEXT; not null; pk 1
  column 1 source_turn_id TEXT; not null; pk 2
  column 2 completion_seq INTEGER; not null
  column 3 evidence_json TEXT; not null
  column 4 manifest_json TEXT; not null; default '[]'
  column 5 state TEXT; not null
  column 6 routing_complete INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 7 candidates_json TEXT; not null; default '[]'
  column 8 terminal_reason TEXT

table pages
  | CREATE TABLE pages (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | parent_id TEXT REFERENCES pages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | title TEXT NOT NULL,
  | color TEXT,
  | blocks TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(blocks)),
  | revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
  | view_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(view_version >= 1),
  | helper_node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' CHECK(updated_by IN ('user','agent')),
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | deleted_at INTEGER,
  | deletion_group_id TEXT
  | , role TEXT CHECK(role IS NULL OR role IN ('spaces-home','workspace-home')), layout_rules TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(layout_rules) AND json_type(layout_rules)='array'), hidden_at INTEGER)
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 parent_id TEXT
  column 4 position INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 5 title TEXT; not null
  column 6 color TEXT
  column 7 blocks TEXT; not null
  column 8 revision INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 9 view_version INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 10 helper_node_id TEXT
  column 11 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 12 updated_by TEXT; not null; default 'user'
  column 13 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 14 deleted_at INTEGER
  column 15 deletion_group_id TEXT
  column 16 role TEXT
  column 17 layout_rules TEXT; not null; default '[]'
  column 18 hidden_at INTEGER
  foreign key 0.0 helper_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 parent_id -> pages(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 2.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pages_spaces_home ON pages(owner_user_id) WHERE role='spaces-home'

  | CREATE INDEX idx_pages_tree ON pages(workspace_id, parent_id, deleted_at, position)
index idx_pages_workspace_home on pages; unique; origin c; partial (workspace_id)
  | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pages_workspace_home ON pages(workspace_id) WHERE role='workspace-home'

table scheduled_job_runs
  | CREATE TABLE scheduled_job_runs (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  | node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | tree_id TEXT,
  | turn_id TEXT,
  | trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger IN ('scheduled', 'manual')),
  | status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted')),
  | scheduled_for INTEGER,
  | started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | finished_at INTEGER,
  | summary TEXT,
  | error TEXT,
  | -- Desktop notification delivery: none | pending | delivered.
  | notify_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (notify_state IN ('none', 'pending', 'delivered')),
  | notify_kind TEXT CHECK (notify_kind IS NULL OR notify_kind IN ('finished', 'attention')),
  | attention TEXT CHECK (attention IS NULL OR attention IN ('approval', 'input')),
  | claimed_by TEXT NOT NULL
  | )
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 job_id TEXT; not null
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 node_id TEXT
  column 4 tree_id TEXT
  column 5 turn_id TEXT
  column 6 trigger TEXT; not null
  column 7 status TEXT; not null
  column 8 scheduled_for INTEGER
  column 9 started_at INTEGER; not null
  column 10 finished_at INTEGER
  column 11 summary TEXT
  column 12 error TEXT
  column 13 notify_state TEXT; not null; default 'none'
  column 14 notify_kind TEXT
  column 15 attention TEXT
  column 16 claimed_by TEXT; not null
  foreign key 0.0 node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 job_id -> scheduled_jobs(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

  | CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_job_runs_job ON scheduled_job_runs(job_id, started_at DESC)

table scheduled_jobs
  | CREATE TABLE scheduled_jobs (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | owner_user_id TEXT,
  | workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  | name TEXT NOT NULL,
  | prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  | schedule TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(schedule) AND json_extract(schedule, '$.kind') IN ('every', 'cron', 'at')),
  | runtime_id TEXT,
  | provider_id TEXT,
  | model_id TEXT,
  | reasoning TEXT,
  | permission_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trust' CHECK (permission_mode IN ('ask', 'trust', 'yolo')),
  | session_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh' CHECK (session_mode IN ('fresh', 'persistent')),
  | persistent_node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  | notify INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  | enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  | auto_paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  | timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800,
  | next_run_at INTEGER,
  | last_run_at INTEGER,
  | last_status TEXT,
  | last_error TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  | , conversation_cursor INTEGER, execution_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled'
  | CHECK(execution_kind IN ('scheduled','maintenance')), visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'workspace')
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 owner_user_id TEXT
  column 2 workspace_id TEXT; not null
  column 3 name TEXT; not null
  column 4 prompt TEXT; not null
  column 5 schedule TEXT; not null
  column 6 runtime_id TEXT
  column 7 provider_id TEXT
  column 8 model_id TEXT
  column 9 reasoning TEXT
  column 10 permission_mode TEXT; not null; default 'trust'
  column 11 session_mode TEXT; not null; default 'fresh'
  column 12 persistent_node_id TEXT
  column 13 notify INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 14 enabled INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 15 auto_paused INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 16 consecutive_failures INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 17 timeout_seconds INTEGER; not null; default 1800
  column 18 next_run_at INTEGER
  column 19 last_run_at INTEGER
  column 20 last_status TEXT
  column 21 last_error TEXT
  column 22 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 23 updated_at INTEGER; not null
  column 24 conversation_cursor INTEGER
  column 25 execution_kind TEXT; not null; default 'scheduled'
  column 26 visibility TEXT; not null; default 'workspace'
  foreign key 0.0 persistent_node_id -> nodes(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete SET NULL; match NONE
  foreign key 1.0 workspace_id -> workspaces(id); on update NO ACTION; on delete CASCADE; match NONE

trigger memory_recall_docs_turn_trust_ai on turn_trust
  | CREATE TRIGGER memory_recall_docs_turn_trust_ai AFTER INSERT ON turn_trust BEGIN
  | UPDATE memory_recall_docs SET read_outside = 1
  | WHERE doc_kind = 'turn' AND ref_id = new.turn_id AND node_id = new.node_id AND read_outside = 0;
  | END

table workspaces
  | CREATE TABLE workspaces (
  | id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  | name TEXT NOT NULL,
  | cwd TEXT,
  | model TEXT,
  | active_tree_id TEXT,
  | created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  | updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000),
  | settings TEXT,
  | deleted_at INTEGER,
  | archived_at INTEGER
  | , backend TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kiro', owner_user_id TEXT, purged_at INTEGER, sync_rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pinned_at INTEGER, persistence_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, folders TEXT)
  column 0 id TEXT; pk 1
  column 1 name TEXT; not null
  column 2 cwd TEXT
  column 3 model TEXT
  column 4 active_tree_id TEXT
  column 5 created_at INTEGER; not null
  column 6 updated_at INTEGER; not null; default strftime('%s','now') * 1000
  column 7 settings TEXT
  column 8 deleted_at INTEGER
  column 9 archived_at INTEGER
  column 10 backend TEXT; not null; default 'kiro'
  column 11 owner_user_id TEXT
  column 12 purged_at INTEGER
  column 13 sync_rev INTEGER; not null; default 0
  column 14 pinned_at INTEGER
  column 15 persistence_version INTEGER; not null; default 1
  column 16 folders TEXT
index idx_workspaces_owner on workspaces; origin c (owner_user_id)
  | CREATE INDEX idx_workspaces_owner ON workspaces(owner_user_id)
index sqlite_autoindex_workspaces_1 on workspaces; unique; origin pk (id)
